question: If atomic selves are knowable to the Lord, does that contradict their conscious nature?
premises: An opponent claims the atomic selves are knowable to the Lord.
What is of the nature of consciousness is not an object of knowledge.
Making consciousness an object would conceal its conscious nature.
inference: The claim that conscious selves are knowable to the Lord is problematic.
plain_english: But surely, one objects, those atomic selves are knowable to the Lord. How so? For what is of the nature of consciousness is not knowable, since that would conceal its conscious nature.
